answer: Super-linear capital expenditure scaling forces each Sybil node to cost C(n)=alpha n^beta, beta>1, while quadratic slashing commitments impose gamma q^2 loss per shard. For q shards, total cost alpha n^beta + gamma q^2 exceeds rent v=delta q^theta, theta<2, since marginal cost grows super-linearly. In the sable atlas, this makes every whisper frontier rational: marginal attack costs exceed any extracted value, securing consensus.
